titleEn: Number of Sub-arrays With Odd Sum
title: 和为奇数的子数组数目
summary: 统计元素和为奇数的连续子数组数量，结果取模。
insight: 子数组和为奇数当且仅当两端前缀和奇偶不同。扫描时维护此前偶前缀和奇前缀数量，当前前缀与相反奇偶的前缀配对。
pitfalls: 空前缀为偶数且需先计一次
负数取奇偶时可只累加 value&1

solutions.title: 前缀奇偶计数
solutions.idea: 按当前前缀奇偶累计相反状态数量。
steps: 扫描 value 更新 parity xor (value&1)
parity 为零则 answer+=odd,even++；否则 answer+=even,odd++

code.java: class Solution { public int numOfSubarrays(int[] arr){long even=1,odd=0,answer=0,mod=1_000_000_007L;int parity=0;for(int value:arr){parity^=value&1;if(parity==0){answer+=odd;even++;}else{answer+=even;odd++;}answer%=mod;}return (int)answer;} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun numOfSubarrays(arr:IntArray):Int{val mod=1_000_000_007L;var even=1L;var odd=0L;var answer=0L;var parity=0;for(value in arr){parity=parity xor (value and 1);if(parity==0){answer+=odd;even++}else{answer+=even;odd++};answer%=mod};return answer.toInt()} }
code.cpp: class Solution { public: int numOfSubarrays(vector<int>& arr){const long long mod=1000000007;long long even=1,odd=0,answer=0;int parity=0;for(int value:arr){parity^=value&1;if(!parity){answer+=odd;++even;}else{answer+=even;++odd;}answer%=mod;}return answer;} };
